claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows

decision.diagnostic_pass: instrumentation is proven loaded by an input-free subprocess and the live run records exact producer retirement method entry/return timestamps or a bounded trace showing which call remains open at callback release.
decision.stop: One fixture, one dispatch, at most one cancel; never replay or retry. Any setup mismatch stops before input.
decision.strict_action_outcome: The R29 strict gate remains unchanged and requires a full 1250 ms post-cancel hold. R35 is a sub-second diagnostic only and can never be reported as strict-gate PASS. It separately tests whether a pre-armed independent state sampler observes Q-up after recovery SendInput returns but before the 700 ms callback release, and whether a distinct second Q-up hook callback is visible below the nominal timeout cap.

environment.host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
environment.low_level_hooks_timeout_registry: HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\LowLevelHooksTimeout absent at R29 preflight; read only

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: After independently proving the fixture is actually in Q-down state, a single held injected Q-up callback and public cancellation will show whether recovery clears that exact key while the hook callback is blocked.

instrumentation.mode: R35 adds a finite 10 ms independent same-generation state series process, started before dispatch, to avoid post-event process startup latency. The Q-up callback hold is 700 ms; cancel is withheld if the projected callback total exceeds 950 ms. No runtime source changes, retry or replay.

nonclaims: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows
resource_boundary: One user-authorized local Windows PC, one owned fixture/window and hook; one dispatch, at most one cancellation, one 700 ms Q-up callback hold; no retries or replay, no registry change, no WSLc or Docker. A separate child process performs finite read-only Q-state sampling.
retry_policy: Input-free frozen-source, R34b predecessor, registry and instrumentation preflight; one fresh fixture and dispatch; require same-generation Q-down baseline and a projected callback duration <=950 ms before one cancel. No retry/replay. Any mismatch stops before cancellation; preserve failure.

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: Fixture click and CTRL+S save occur before cancellation, as in R34b. This remains independent fixture effect only; no post-recovery task success is claimed.

native_stimulus.event: first injected VK_Q WM_KEYUP after the injected Q-down callback returned and independent same-generation readback proved Q-down
native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: Hold only the first Q-up callback for 700 ms after the cancel response; release at the frozen hold end or the 1500 ms self-deadline. A pre-armed independent readback child samples same-generation Q state every 10 ms from before dispatch. Abort before cancel if projected callback duration would exceed 950 ms; keep the documented Windows timeout confound below the nominal 1000 ms cap.

trial.pre_cancel_readback: After hook entry, interface_results must show action status running before one interface_cancel call.
trial.target: One fresh owned fixture process/window and one exact generation; require independent Q-down true before the single cancel.
